newsitem.title: HONG KONG: IBA to raise HK$495 mln in share issue.
newsitem.headline: IBA to raise HK$495 mln in share issue.

text.p: International Bank of Asia Ltd (IBA) will raise a net HK$495 million in expansion capital through the issue of 109.92 million new shares, the company said in an announcement published on Tuesday.

Major shareholders of IBA, Arab Banking Corp and China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, will subscribe for a total of 109.92 million new shares after placing out 27.48 million old shares, thus boosting the capital base of the banking company while and maintaining their shareholdings at the same level.

The placing price is HK$4.55 and represents a 3.2 percent discount to the closing price of HK$4.70 per share on Monday, and a 2.8 percent discount to the simple average of closing prices for the five business days immediately prior to the placing of HK$4.68, the announcement said.
The issue price for new shares is equivalent to the placing price subtracting the costs and expenses of the placing.

The company estimates the net proceeds from the issue will be HK$495 million and plans to use the funds to acquire sites for new branches, to upgrade Philippines finance arm, to expand its China-related business, to install new technology and for general working capital purposes, the announcement said.

Arab Banking Corp, which holds 55 percent of the issued share capital of IBA, will place 20.15 million shares then subscribe for 80.61 million shares, while China Everbright, which holds 20.0 percent of the company, will place 7.33 million shares then subscribe for 29.31 million new shares.
The subscription shares represent 17.3 percent of the existing share capital of the company, or 14.7 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of the company
Peregrine Capital Ltd and ABN Amro HK Asia Ltd are the placing agents of the issue.
